parameters.body/messageBody: {"$schema": "http://adaptivecards.io/schemas/adaptive-card.json", "type": "AdaptiveCard", "version": "1.4", "body": [{"type": "TextBlock", "text": "@{coalesce(triggerBody()?['title'], '❌ Build Fallido')}", "weight": "Bolder", "size": "Large", "color": "Attention", "wrap": true}, {"type": "FactSet", "facts": [{"title": "Estado", "value": "@{coalesce(triggerBody()?['status'], 'FALLIDO')}"}, {"title": "Build #", "value": "@{triggerBody()?['build_number']}"}, {"title": "Repositorio", "value": "@{coalesce(triggerBody()?['repository'], triggerBody()?['app_name'])}"}, {"title": "Commit", "value": "@{triggerBody()?['commit']}"}, {"title": "Rama", "value": "@{triggerBody()?['branch']}"}, {"title": "Ambiente", "value": "@{triggerBody()?['environment']}"}, {"title": "Mensaje", "value": "@{coalesce(triggerBody()?['message'], 'Build fallido')}"}, {"title": "Error", "value": "@{coalesce(triggerBody()?['error'], 'Sin error reportado')}"}]}, {"type": "TextBlock", "text": "Error: @{coalesce(triggerBody()?['error'], 'Sin error reportado')}", "wrap": true, "isVisible": "@{not(empty(triggerBody()?['error']))}", "color": "Attention", "spacing": "Small"}], "actions": [{"type": "Action.OpenUrl", "title": "Ver build en Jenkins", "url": "@{triggerBody()?['build_url']}"}]}
